name: @retroplug/native
description: RetroPlug's native shell (C++): the engine, the graph and script hosts, the RPC services, the offline job pool and the hosts. Each console, the host's I/O nodes and the system contract are packages of their own (sameboy, mesen, host-io, system); this tree registers no node type, and its library is what the products link. Built via the top-level CMake.
